title: New Covenant, New Heart, New Spirit

sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: During these times, God sent many servants called prophets to share a message. They repeated what God said. Sometimes they spoke about future events that would happen if the people didn’t change their ways. They also warned about God’s judgment for past actions. They predicted the future virgin birth of the Messiah and that the Messiah would die on the cross to pay for the sins of all people.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Eventually, God allowed both Israel and Judah to be conquered by other nations and His temple to be destroyed. Finally, after many years in exile, the children of Israel were allowed to return. Through it all, they were waiting for God to send His Savior, and this story is according to the word of God.
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.

These verses teach us that God's grace transforms us from within. God does not say, "Fix yourself, and then I will accept you." He says, "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you." The change we could never achieve on our own, God has promised to accomplish in us. This is the new covenant of Jesus Christ, who forgives our sins and gives us a new heart through the Holy Spirit.
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: The human heart often wants things that we knows are wrong or harmful. Let’s ask God for clean hearts that desire only what is good and true and beautiful.
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
